issues.on_page: Other sources (uses): Capital improvements - Land, building, and equipment (17,655)
issues.issue: this is capital spending (it is the Capital outlay 17,655 on p2), not a transfer or financing item. It is entered as 'other financing' because the schedule prints it under Other Sources (Uses), so the Fair detail expenditures (430,738) leave out capital outlay. It is already marked review.

taxes and licenses paid don't fit 'dues, training and travel' well. Miscellaneous expenditure is arguably the better fit. The same applies to detail[42] (Speedway 15,960) and detail[48] (Concessions 2,958). All three are already marked review.

the label mixes grants (possibly from a government, which would be intergovernmental/state aid or federal grants) with private donations. Nothing on the page says where the grants came from, and the line has no review note. The same applies to detail[8] and detail[16].
